title: Log in as Admin and reach the dashboard
description: Admin can sign in with seeded credentials and land on the dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill email with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill password with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Click Sign In
URL contains /dashboard and dashboard content is visible

title: Create a new patient record
description: Staff creates a patient with name, age, gender, phone and sees them in the list.

steps.description: Login as Admin
Navigate to /cases/patients
Click Add Patient
Fill Patient Name, Age, Gender, Phone with unique values
Click Register Patient
New patient name appears in the patients table

title: Create a LAB bill with tests
description: Create invoice for a patient with at least one test.

steps.description: Login as Admin
Navigate to /cases/bills/new
Select a registered patient from the patient picker
Add at least one lab test
Click Create Invoice
New bill appears in the bills list with the patient name

title: Collect payment using Pay button
description: Collect payment by clicking the Pay button (data-testid bill-pay), not table cells.

steps.description: Login as Admin. Open /cases/bills/new and create a LAB bill for any patient with at least one test, leave it unpaid (do not collect payment yet).
Open /cases/bills and find an invoice with due amount > 0. Click Pay button data-testid=bill-pay
Enter payment amount and mode, confirm payment
Payment succeeds and due becomes zero or Paid status shows

title: Download bill invoice PDF
description: Download invoice via PDF button data-testid bill-pdf.

steps.description: Login as Admin and open /cases/bills
Click PDF button data-testid=bill-pdf on any bill row
Visible status text data-testid=bill-pdf-started appears saying Invoice PDF download started — do NOT require observing browser download dialog

title: Full report flow: enter results submit Reported
description: From pending case enter results, save draft, submit to Reported.

steps.description: Login as Admin
Navigate to /lab/result-entry
Open a pending lab case or create result report for a billed case
Enter result values for tests
Save draft then submit results
Report status shows Reported or equivalent success confirmation

title: Sign a reported lab report
description: Admin signs a Reported report to Signed status.

steps.description: Login as Admin. If no Reported report exists, open a pending/registered lab report, enter results, submit to Reported status first
Open Result Verification / reports queue and find a report with status Reported
Open the report and complete Sign
Report status becomes Signed or Sign control confirms success

title: Verify a signed lab report
description: Admin verifies signed/reported report to Verified.

steps.description: Login as Admin
Open /lab/reports
Verify a Signed or Reported report
Report status becomes Verified

title: Preview and download staff report PDF
description: Open report preview and download PDF from staff workspace.

steps.description: Login as Admin
Open /lab/reports and open a completed report preview
Download or print the report PDF
PDF loads without rate-limit or error banner

title: Open real public report QR link and download PDF
description: Obtain real qrToken from UI QR, open /r/{token} logged out, download PDF. Never use /r/demo.

steps.description: Login as Admin, open a completed report, click QR and copy the real verify URL containing /r/
Open that exact URL in a fresh session without staff login
Public page shows report details, not Link not valid
Click Download if available
PDF download succeeds

title: Open real public bill QR link
description: Use bill-qr button to get real /r/bill/{token}; never use test-token.

steps.description: Login as Admin, open /cases/bills, click QR (data-testid=bill-qr) and copy verify URL
Open that /r/bill/{token} URL logged out
Bill details are shown, not Link not valid

title: Patient portal OTP view reports and download PDF
description: Patient requests OTP, verifies, views My Reports, downloads PDF.

steps.description: Open patient portal, request OTP, click data-testid=use-dev-otp, Verify
Open any report (View Report)
Click Download PDF / Download Official Signed PDF (data-testid=report-pdf-download). Do NOT look for bill-pdf-started
data-testid=report-pdf-started appears OR download button click succeeds without error alert

title: Create a new Employee user
description: Admin creates employee at /manage/employees with email and password.

steps.description: Login as Admin and open /manage/employees
Click Create user. Fill Full Name, unique Email, Password. Do not toggle LAB. Click Save user once
Success banner User created successfully OR new email appears in user list. Do NOT require re-checking LAB chip after modal closes

title: Login as newly created Employee
description: New employee can login and reach dashboard; Admin routes blocked.

steps.description: Create a NEW unique employee if needed at /manage/employees with email employee.loginok@purepathlab.in password EmpPass123! (LAB preselected — do not toggle). If email already exists, skip create.
Logout. On login page stay on Password tab — NEVER click Login with Email OTP. Sign in as employee.loginok@purepathlab.in / EmpPass123!
Employee reaches /dashboard
Navigate to /business/daily
Access denied or redirected away from business analytics

title: Deactivate employee and confirm login fails
description: Admin sets employee Inactive; login fails.

steps.description: Login as Admin, open /manage/employees
Find employee row and click data-testid=user-deactivate (sticky Actions column). Confirm Deactivate in dialog
Logout and attempt password login as that employee
Login fails or account inactive message shown

title: Create or edit a delivery notification template
description: Admin saves an SMS/email template at /delivery/templates.

steps.description: Login as Admin
Navigate to /delivery/templates
Create or edit a template with key, channel, and body
Save the template
Template row is visible in the list after save

title: Edit lab profile branding and preview document PDF
description: Update lab profile and open document preview.

steps.description: Login as Admin and open Lab Profile / document format settings
Make a small branding or format change so Save is enabled
Click Save changes (data-testid=lab-profile-save) and/or Preview selected format as PDF
Notice Lab profile saved appears OR PDF preview iframe is visible. Do NOT look for bill-pdf-started

title: Activate an existing signature
description: Admin activates an existing inactive signature at /settings/signatures without uploading.

steps.description: Login as Admin and open /settings/signatures
If page shows Empty state, the run already seeded an Inactive signature — Refresh once. Click data-testid=signature-activate on an Inactive row. Never open Add signature and never upload an image
At least one signature shows Active status or Activate control becomes Deactivate

title: Review USG report templates list
description: Admin opens /usg/templates and sees template list.

steps.description: Login as Admin
Navigate to /usg/templates
Templates page loads with a table or empty state without error

title: Create a USG case
description: Create a new USG case on /usg/today.

steps.description: Login as Admin
Navigate to /usg/today
Create a new USG case with required fields; use a template if picker is available
New USG case appears in the cases list

title: Create an X-Ray case without requiring image upload
description: Create X-Ray case with findings only; image upload is optional and must be skipped.

steps.description: Login as Admin and open /xray/today
If list shows No records found, switch date filter to All if available, otherwise continue
Click Create X-Ray Case
Select any existing patient, enter findings text Autotest findings. Do NOT attach a scan file.
Click Save Case once and wait for modal to close
New case appears in the list OR findings text Autotest findings is visible after refresh

title: Create a lab test in the catalog
description: Admin creates a test at /lab/tests.

steps.description: Login as Admin
Navigate to /lab/tests
Create a new test with required fields
New test appears in the catalog

title: Create a new branch
description: Admin creates a branch at /manage/branches.

steps.description: Login as Admin
Navigate to /manage/branches
Create a branch with a unique name
Branch appears in the list

title: Review daily business for a date range
description: Admin opens daily business and filters by date.

steps.description: Login as Admin
Navigate to /business/daily
Apply a date range filter if available
Daily business page loads data or empty state without rate-limit error

title: Export a business CSV dataset
description: Admin exports CSV from /business/export.

steps.description: Login as Admin
Navigate to /business/export
Select a dataset and export CSV
Export completes without rate-limit error

title: Dashboard loads with quick actions
description: Dashboard shows stats/quick actions after login.

steps.description: Login as Admin and open /dashboard
Dashboard content and at least one quick action link are visible
Click a quick action
Navigation reaches the target page

title: Search existing patient
description: Search patients list finds an existing patient.

steps.description: Login as Admin, open /cases/patients
Search by patient name or phone
Matching patient row is shown

title: View today lab reports queue
description: Todays reports page loads.

steps.description: Login as Admin, open /lab/reports
Reports list or empty state is visible

title: Invalid login shows error
description: Wrong password stays on login with error.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Enter valid email and wrong password
Click Sign In
Still on login page with an error message

title: Invalid public token shows Link not valid
description: Opening /r/not-a-real-token shows invalid link message.

steps.description: Navigate to /r/not-a-real-token
Page shows Link not valid or Invalid or expired verification link

title: Update an existing patient
description: Edit patient demographics and save.

steps.description: Login as Admin, open a patient, edit a field, save
Updated value is shown

title: Update an existing lab test
description: Edit a catalog test and save.

steps.description: Login as Admin, open /lab/tests, edit a test, save
Updated test is visible

title: Review packages panels and rates
description: Open packages, panels, and rate list pages.

steps.description: Login as Admin
Open /lab/packages, /lab/panels, /lab/rates
Each page loads without error

title: Update an existing USG case
description: Edit a USG case and save.

steps.description: Login as Admin, open /usg/today, update a case
Updated case is saved

title: View X-Ray reports list
description: Open /xray/reports.

steps.description: Login as Admin, open /xray/reports
Page loads with list or empty state

title: Review monthly business and expenses
description: Open monthly business and expenses pages.

steps.description: Login as Admin, open /business/monthly and /business/expenses
Both pages load without rate-limit error

title: Update an existing branch
description: Edit branch and save.

steps.description: Login as Admin, open /manage/branches, edit a branch
Updated branch is visible

title: Delete a branch
description: Delete a non-critical branch if allowed.

steps.description: Login as Admin, delete a test branch if UI allows
Branch is removed or delete is confirmed

title: Adjust lab document format options
description: Change document format toggles on lab profile.

steps.description: Login as Admin, open /setup/profile, toggle a document option, save
Save succeeds

title: Open USG case using a template when available
description: Create/open USG case selecting a template.

steps.description: Login as Admin, open /usg/today, create/open case with template if available
Case form shows template content or case is saved

title: Open landing page Admin login entry
description: From / click Admin Panel to /login.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click Admin Panel or login entry
Login page is shown

title: Open patient portal from landing
description: From landing open patient report portal.

steps.description: Navigate to / and open patient portal link
Patient report portal OTP form is visible

title: Reject invalid patient OTP
description: Wrong OTP shows error.

steps.description: Open /patient/report, request OTP, enter wrong OTP
Error is shown and reports are not unlocked

title: View today USG cases list
description: USG today page loads.

steps.description: Login as Admin, open /usg/today
Cases list or empty state visible

title: View today X-Ray cases list
description: X-Ray today page loads.

steps.description: Login as Admin, open /xray/today
Cases list or empty state visible
